title: a carry or a give-back regenerates the plans of everyone its links reach
line: John Y Davidson's death certificate decided on FamilySearch's page of it, him by the owner and his mother Ellen on it, which writes his membership of his parents' family; the certificate's image, read by the model, takes both decisions as a copy of the record, and the carry writes the same membership from the image: inside the reading the plan of his father John Young Davidson, the family's other partner and neither end of the link, is regenerated with theirs; the owner's word that the image is another record gives the link back, and his plan is regenerated in that word too

steps.say: FamilySearch's page of his death certificate, matched for him and his mother
the owner accepts him on it
and his mother: her decision writes his membership of his parents' family

expect.why: his plan as her decision left it: the decision itself reaches him, the family's other partner

steps.say: the certificate's image, archived under the same citation
the model reads the deceased from the image, typed by the harness from its own words: John Young Davidson, 71, died the 11th day of June 1946 at Franklin, Simpson County, state file 14205
and his mother from line 14, her maiden name: Ellen McCreary

expect.why: a copy of the record the owner decided: her entry takes her decision, no card
the carry writes his membership from the image, the copy that states it
the link the carry wrote is a membership of his family: his plan is regenerated inside the reading, as a decision regenerates the plans of everyone its links reach, though he is neither end of it

steps.say: the owner's word: the image is not this record

copies.note: harness: the image kept apart to see what the decision carried to it given back

expect.why: the membership the carry wrote goes back with the decisions
the link given back is a membership of his family: his plan is regenerated in the owner's word
